description: Pull every bank, card, and brokerage account through SimpleFIN into a local SQLite ledger — with net worth, cash flow, recurring-charge detection, and holdings gain/loss no single bank app can show.

tools.name: accounts_list
tools.description: Live fetch the full Account Set (all institutions) from the SimpleFIN server. Optional: start-date, end-date, pending (plus 3 more). Returns the AccountSet.

params.name: start-date
params.description: Only return transactions on or after this date (unix epoch, or relative like 30d/1w). Max 90-day span per call.

params.name: end-date
params.description: Only return transactions before this date (unix epoch, or relative).

params.name: pending
params.description: Set to 1 to include pending transactions.

params.name: account
params.description: Restrict to a specific account id. Repeatable upstream; pass comma-separated.

params.name: balances-only
params.description: Set to 1 to skip transaction data and return balances only.

tools.name: info_get
tools.description: Report which SimpleFIN protocol versions the server supports. Returns the ServerInfo.
